note: Monona County park on a former gravel-pit lake 1 mi east of Rodney; three handicap sites, tent area, group area. Swim beach, boat ramp, dock, playground, .9-mile walking trail. --Claude
summary: County page confirms 49 pads (26 full), 20-50A, FCFS, year-round, $20-25. Amps, count, vault toilets, potable water added. Note cleaned. Lakefront holds with new evidence.
flags: WATERFRONT holds at lakefront, evidence now read (none was stored): on z19 imagery the south row of back-in pads along the north shore has its tips ~20-30 m from the waterline over open mown grass, with no road or day use between; the campground road runs on the back of that row. The north row is across the road and so isn't on-water. Lake here is about 350 x 300 m (about 20 acres); county says 'the combined 42 acres of water' across three pits, well over the 5-acre floor. Suggested evidence: 'z19 Esri 2026-11-02: south-row pads ~20-30 m open grass to gravel-pit lake, road behind them'.

LONG-STAY: nothing on the county page sells monthly or seasonal and it is FCFS, with no seasonal evidence on imagery (pads empty in the capture). Google 4 weeks ago: 'I ended up staying 14 days'. No gate; public entry. Google 4.6 on 27.

Pin 42.1995,-95.9438 is on the swim-beach day-use area at the east side; about 150 m from the sites' overall centre and ~230 m from the west arc: inside 250 m, no move. Noise review, Google 5 months ago: a flag pole dinging all day.
RV Life lists this as 'Rodney Pits Recreation Area' with park_type commercial, a mislabel: the county runs it. ownership local is right.
